text.tspan: Docker: package once, run anywhere; images live in a registry
• Software development platform to deploy apps
• Apps are packaged in CONTAINERS that
• Apps run the same wherever they run:
no guest OS: resources shared with the host
Getting started: build → push → pull → run
Where are images stored? Docker repositories
images for many technologies or OS (Ubuntu, MySQL...)
• Amazon ECR: private repository + public repository
• Docker is "sort of" a virtualization technology, but not exactly
• Resources are shared with the host → MANY containers
• A VM carries a full guest OS; a container only the app
and its libraries (shares the host kernel)
